announcements.headline: 3Q26 Production Report
announcements.insight: Fresnillo issues its third-quarter production report. This operational update follows the August interim results and September CFO succession announcement.

announcements.headline: Planned CFO Succession
announcements.insight: Fresnillo announces a planned CFO succession. This follows its recent interim results and dividend conversion rate disclosure.

announcements.headline: Conversion rate for 2026 Interim Dividend
announcements.insight: Fresnillo sets the conversion rate for its 2026 interim dividend following the June results. This confirms the payment terms for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Interim Results for the six months to 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Fresnillo released interim results for the six months to 30 June 2026. This follows a July 2026 disclosure under Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2).

announcements.headline: Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2) Disclosure
announcements.insight: Fresnillo has made a Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2) disclosure. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the specific transaction or event triggering this notification.
